description: Canonical software-question scope for the all-question execution validation. This is a scope inventory, not a claim that all answers have automatic correctness suites.
selection_rule: Match the website questionCategory: use explicit assets.category first; select software. Subject relevant_programming alone also includes two hardware questions and is not equivalent.
live_inventory_status: All 63 matching live questions were trial; trial questions remain servable even when parity_checked is false. Database/API state must be rechecked on every live validation.

validation_layers.transport: For every question, authenticated capabilities, complete-program execution and isolated runner errors can be validated independently of answer correctness.
validation_layers.configured_suite: Only suite_languages declares existing question-specific checks. The exact current contract and cases are owned by backend/seeds/execution_cases.json.
validation_layers.standalone: Without a configured suite, successful compilation/execution is completed with correctness unassessed; never convert it to a full answer pass.
validation_layers.review: Complexity, prohibited operations, node/reference identity, memory bounds, instruction restrictions, distributions and conceptual explanations may require review beyond ordinary output cases.

questions.title_en: Find an array boundary error
questions.validation_scope: C boundary repair needs n=0/null, singleton and exact n-element checks; a successful C compilation does not prove memory safety.

questions.title_en: Validate nested brackets
questions.validation_scope: Return a Boolean for correctly nested (), [] and {}. Empty input is valid. python: is_balanced(text).

questions.title_en: Fixed-capacity circular queue
questions.validation_scope: Standalone queue demonstration needs full/empty, wraparound, order and state assertions; successful process exit alone establishes none of these.

questions.title_en: Count asserted status bits
questions.validation_scope: Return the number of set bits in an unsigned 32-bit value. Python/JavaScript: count_set_bits(n). C/C++: uint32_t count_set_bits(uint32_t n), returning 0/1 for a Boolean. Do not define main.

questions.title_en: Extract a register field
questions.validation_scope: Return the right-aligned field. Inputs obey the prompt and include width=32. python: extract_field(reg, lsb, width).

questions.title_en: First element at least a target
questions.validation_scope: Return the first index with value at least target, or the array length. python: lower_bound(a, target).

questions.title_en: Merge sorted measurement lists
questions.validation_scope: Return the merged sorted array, preserving every duplicate. python: merge(a, b).

questions.title_en: Find two distinct matching indices
questions.validation_scope: Return [i,j] for distinct indices, or null/None when absent. Cases have a unique pair; index order is unrestricted. python: pair_sum(a, target).

questions.title_en: Recognize a power of two
questions.validation_scope: Return a Boolean indicating whether unsigned32 n is a power of two. Zero is not. Python/JavaScript: is_power_of_two(n). C/C++: uint32_t is_power_of_two(uint32_t n), returning 0/1 for a Boolean. Do not define main.

questions.title_en: Reverse a linked list in place
questions.validation_scope: A linked-node harness must check original node identity, acyclic reversed links, empty input and no node loss; printing reversed values is insufficient.

questions.title_en: Reversing an abstract list using Head, Tail and concatenation
questions.validation_scope: Head/Tail/concat alone lack an empty test and singleton constructor; executable examples use the explicitly completed interface and must state concatenation cost.

questions.title_en: Print every distinct string permutation
questions.validation_scope: Test adapter: permutations(text) returns every distinct permutation as an array instead of printing. Order is arbitrary; no duplicates. Empty input gives [""].

questions.title_en: All unique value triples summing to S — and the index alternative
questions.validation_scope: Unique lexicographically ordered value triples differ from all index triples; duplicate occurrences and output-size bounds need separate checks.

questions.title_en: ASCII-letter palindrome — compare without normalization
questions.validation_scope: Implement is_palindrome(text) for ASCII letters with case-sensitive comparison. Only promised valid inputs are tested.

questions.title_en: Validate brackets in mixed text
questions.validation_scope: Implement is_balanced(text), ignoring characters outside (), [] and {}. Return a Boolean; quotes/comments have no special syntax.

questions.title_en: Binary tree versus BST and finding the maximum
questions.validation_scope: A general-tree harness must cover empty trees, non-BST structure and negative payloads; the conceptual tree/BST explanation is reviewed separately.

questions.title_en: Byte popcount: scan, parallel groups and lookup
questions.validation_scope: Return a byte's set-bit count. Output checks cannot establish loop-free operation or table use. Python/JavaScript: popcount8(n). C/C++: uint32_t popcount8(uint32_t n), no main; input 0..255.

questions.title_en: Closest pair of points in the plane
questions.validation_scope: The C contract returns original distinct indices and exact uint64 squared distance for bounded integer coordinates; duplicate coordinates, allocation failure and invalid input need dedicated assertions.

questions.title_en: Array with constant-time Set, Get and SetAll
questions.validation_scope: Set/Get/SetAll requires operation-sequence and object-reference tests; finite output samples cannot prove O(1) operations or preserve reference identity.

questions.title_en: Polygon convexity — vertex order and simplicity matter
questions.validation_scope: Weak and strict convexity differ and the default assumes simple ordered boundaries; outputs alone do not validate that promise or arbitrary unordered points.

questions.title_en: Costume assignment: serving people before preference rank
questions.validation_scope: The source supplies four preference rows, not five; correctness requires assignment validity and lexicographic maximization of served count then first choices, allowing ties.

questions.title_en: Count negatives in a row-and-column-sorted matrix
questions.validation_scope: Sorting directions and rectangular-shape handling matter; sample answers cannot establish the promised submatrix-scan access cost.

questions.title_en: Count primes up to n with the Sieve of Eratosthenes
questions.validation_scope: The range is inclusive 1..n with zero for n<2; samples cannot establish sieve implementation, complexity or all input sizes.

questions.title_en: How many array pairs sum to S?
questions.validation_scope: Count index-pair multiplicities with i<j, not unique value pairs; duplicates, negatives and no input mutation need dedicated cases.

questions.title_en: C++ destructors, resource ownership and virtual destruction
questions.validation_scope: This is a C++17 ownership/destruction explanation with examples; compiling an example cannot grade ownership reasoning or justify a virtual base destructor.

questions.title_en: Sort 2000 using a 1000-value box: define the memory-access model
questions.validation_scope: The three explicit memory-transfer models have different costs; sorted output does not establish minimal external accesses or a hardware timing claim.

questions.title_en: Delete values below 19 — indices and edge cases
questions.validation_scope: A Del(i) harness must check shifting indices, survivor order/multiplicity and retaining 19; deletion count differs from suffix-shifting cost.

questions.title_en: Seven boom: emit output only when the digit occurs
questions.validation_scope: Emit once per integer containing decimal digit 7; divisibility by seven is not requested. Large-range cost and incremental-state reasoning need separate review.

questions.title_en: First equal index in a sorted array
questions.validation_scope: Implement first_equal(a,value), returning the first index or -1 when absent. Logarithmic complexity also needs reasoning review. python: first_equal(a, value).

questions.title_en: Draw a horizontal bitmap line without changing surrounding pixels
questions.validation_scope: A bitmap harness must verify MSB-first masks, pitch/padding, surrounding bits, zero length and reject-before-write behavior.

questions.title_en: Find the first shared node of two linked lists
questions.validation_scope: The answer concerns identical nodes and a shared tail, not equal values; a pointer-identity fixture is required for correctness.

questions.title_en: Longest contiguous interval whose sum is divisible by three
questions.validation_scope: Implement longest_mod3(a) for positive inputs; return [length,start,end] with inclusive end. No interval gives [0,null,null]. Ties prefer earlier start then end.

questions.title_en: Maximum-sum contiguous subarray
questions.validation_scope: Array part only: max_subarray(a) returns [sum,start,end] with inclusive zero-based bounds, or null/None for empty input. Ties prefer earliest start then earliest end. The stream interface is not tested.

questions.title_en: Maximum of two integers without comparisons
questions.validation_scope: Exact Python/abs and signed-32-bit/unsigned-bitwise variants differ; outputs alone do not verify forbidden comparisons or signed-overflow safety.

questions.title_en: Merge two sorted arrays without losing duplicates
questions.validation_scope: Fresh-output merge and reserved-capacity mutation are distinct variants; duplicate multiplicities, real zeros and input identities need explicit assertions.

questions.title_en: Minimum workers from weighted interval demand
questions.validation_scope: Inclusive integer days and half-open continuous intervals require different endpoint handling; growing CPU-log queries assume a consistent finite snapshot.

questions.title_en: Multiplication with four registers and unit instructions
questions.validation_scope: The restricted register program requires an interpreter enforcing the allowed four-register operations and zero/nonzero jumps; compiling Python multiplication is not validation of the submitted instruction program.

questions.title_en: One active bit in an int32 pattern, including the sign bit
questions.validation_scope: Implement is_one_bit_active(n), returning a Boolean over the whole int32 pattern, including the sign bit; INT32_MIN is true.

questions.title_en: Find one or two values removed from an array
questions.validation_scope: Part C only: missing_zero_to_n(a), n=len(a), contains distinct values in 0..n. Return the one missing value. The 1..N/two-omission parts are not tested here.

questions.title_en: Does an array contain a pair with a target sum?
questions.validation_scope: Return a boolean using distinct occurrences, allowing duplicate values; samples do not establish the complexity and memory tradeoff.

questions.title_en: Minimum and maximum with optimal comparisons
questions.validation_scope: Returned extrema alone do not establish ceil(3N/2)-2 element comparisons, empty behavior or optimality proof.

questions.title_en: Point in a polygon — ray crossing parity
questions.validation_scope: The main contract assumes perimeter order, simplicity and a point off every supporting line; boundary/self-intersection extensions require separate policies.

questions.title_en: Evaluate a postfix expression with a stack
questions.validation_scope: Implement evaluate_postfix(tokens) with integer tokens and +,-,*. Only valid expressions are executed; invalid-input handling is reviewed separately.

questions.title_en: Power-of-two test with a constant number of operations
questions.validation_scope: Implement is_power_of_two(n) for unsigned32, returning a Boolean. Tests check output; the operation-count argument is reviewed separately. C/C++ signature: uint32_t is_power_of_two(uint32_t n), returning 0/1; no main.

questions.title_en: Product and absolute difference in a four-instruction register language
questions.validation_scope: Requires an educational interpreter enforcing immediate arithmetic-result branching, natural registers and forbidden DEC-at-zero; the 26-register/HALT and eight-register/fallthrough variants differ.

questions.title_en: Random permutation without duplicates
questions.validation_scope: Permutation, array and pixel variants need bounded independent random-draw contracts and no-loss/no-duplicate checks; one random output does not establish uniformity.

questions.title_en: When recursion helps, and what it costs
questions.validation_scope: This is a conceptual comparison using nonnegative summation examples; matching sums cannot grade readability, base-case proofs, stack limits or the recursion cost discussion.

questions.title_en: Reverse eight bits without an array
questions.validation_scope: Return the reversal of all eight bits, including leading zeros. This tests only the fixed-eight-bit part. Python/JavaScript: reverse8(n). C/C++: uint32_t reverse8(uint32_t n), no main; input 0..255.

questions.title_en: Reverse word order by reusing character reversal
questions.validation_scope: Part B: reverse_words(text) returns reversed word order, retaining all characters and reversing the order of space runs. Mandatory reuse of the character-reversal function needs review.

questions.title_en: Detect a linked-list cycle with two pointers
questions.validation_scope: Finite static nodes may cycle by identity; empty, self-cycle, cycle entry and link preservation need a linked-node harness.

questions.title_en: 64 slots and 32 external control bits — an in-band free list
questions.validation_scope: Free-slot link metadata is permitted while allocated 64-bit payload must remain intact; repeated/stale free is explicitly outside the contract.

questions.title_en: Software Fibonacci — recursion, complexity and improvements
questions.validation_scope: Implement fibonacci(n) for 0..30, with F0=0,F1=1. Tests check values; recursion versus iteration and complexity require reasoning review.

questions.title_en: Stack with constant-time minimum
questions.validation_scope: Needs duplicate-minimum and empty-operation sequence tests; samples alone do not prove the O(1) primitive bound or exception semantics.

questions.title_en: Best buy and sell days for one stock transaction
questions.validation_scope: Must enforce buy<sell, optional no-trade behavior and earliest-buy/earliest-sell ties; mandatory-loss variant has a separate contract.

questions.title_en: Swap two numbers without a temporary — including 8-bit values
questions.validation_scope: Unbounded arithmetic, defined 8-bit modular wrap and aliased storage need separate checks; output pairs do not prove the no-temporary restriction.

questions.title_en: Allocate 32 memory slots using one occupancy bitmap
questions.validation_scope: A stateful harness must test exhaustion, lowest-free choice and invalid/double free. The hardware push/pop extension additionally needs reset and simultaneous-request timing tests.

questions.title_en: In-place three-color array partition in linear time
questions.validation_scope: Numeric 0/1/2 extension: sort012(a) mutates and returns the sorted array. Tests compare the returned values only; in-place operation, one traversal and memory use need review.

questions.title_en: Did the turtle return to its starting position?
questions.validation_scope: Simulate one sequence of uppercase R/L/M; final position, not final heading or repeated-sequence boundedness, determines the result.

questions.title_en: Two omissions in 0 through n+1 — no auxiliary array
questions.validation_scope: Implement two_missing(a): n distinct entries from 0..n+1. Return both missing numbers in any order. Tests do not measure auxiliary storage.

questions.title_en: From Random5 to Random7 without bias
questions.validation_scope: Independent uniform Random5 calls and rejection are required; samples cannot prove exact uniformity, expected calls or almost-sure termination.

questions.title_en: Find the unique odd-frequency digit
questions.validation_scope: Requires the promised frequency pattern and digit domain; returned digit samples do not prove complexity or the lower-bound explanation.

questions.title_en: Unsigned integer to binary text in C
questions.validation_scope: The C API includes actual capacity, NUL termination, NULL and no writes on failure; a printed binary string alone does not validate buffer safety.

questions.title_en: Zero matrix rows and columns from original zeros
questions.validation_scope: Only original zero locations trigger clearing; harness must check same-object mutation, rectangular validation before writes and no propagated clearing.

seed_hash_format: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(full seed question, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(comma, colon)), with no trailing newline.
